name: CHROMEWORKS Luminary Spectrum-7 Fashion Eye
description:
The Luminary Spectrum-7 is a full-replacement fashion ocular featuring a continuously color-shifting iris driven by a 16-million-hue electrochromic membrane, holographic pupil pattern overlays selectable from a library of 400 licensed designs, and an optional bioluminescent sclera mode that emits a soft, tunable glow visible in low-light environments. The lens surface is hydrophilic self-cleaning sapphire composite, and iris animations are programmable via the companion neural-tap app. Chromeworks' signature seamless neural integration means color-shift response feels instinctive — the eyes reflect mood cues before the wearer consciously commands them.

Spectrum-7s are the aspirational ocular of GLMZ's Canopy and Spire social circuits, worn by performers, influencers, and anyone who considers their body a curated aesthetic object. A glowing pair at a Tier 4 gallery opening signals money and taste; the same eyes on a the Gray Zone kid who saved for three years signals something more complicated — hunger, ambition, or the specific defiance of looking expensive in a place that expects you to look disposable.
installation_requirements: Standard ocular extraction; Chromeworks-certified aesthetic technician recommended for color calibration
rejection_risk: Low — sapphire composite and Chromeworks biocompatible coating minimize inflammation; standard immunosuppressant course sufficient
maintenance: Monthly app sync for iris pattern library updates; annual lens polish; bioluminescent cell replacement every 18 months
